store.summary: CC1101 Sub-GHz waterfall, signal snapshot/histogram, ML & .sub studio
store.description: RF Heatmap turns your CardputerZero with Cap CC1101 into an on-device Sub-GHz spectrum, signal snapshot, and ML lab. Sweep 315/433/868/915 MHz with an Inferno thermal waterfall, EMI room diff, and SpectrumNet-2D RollJam alerts; inspect any captured signal with a zoomable OOK square-wave snapshot and dual-polarity microsecond pulse-width histogram; classify 28 RF protocols with Pure-Go INT8 PulseNet-RF; decode fixed/rolling codes, TPMS and weather sensors; run Foxhunt Geiger mode, RAW Trimmer, Auto-Probe, DB sync, and an opt-in 40-tool stdio MCP server.
